priceSnapshot.note: THE CONFIRMATION ARRIVED. Spot 64,440.0 against midday's 64,273.2 - up 166.8 points, +0.26%, in six and three quarter hours, and +2.64% on the 24-hour. Midday published an add gate at a settled 4H close above 64,427.4 and attached a second condition the desk had been asking for since the morning session: rising open interest, as the first evidence that a buyer rather than a coverer was doing the work. The 20:00Z 4H bar settled at 64,532.4, clearing the gate by 105.0 points. Open interest is $2,078,856,250 against midday's $2,053,725,764 - UP $25,130,486, +1.22% - the first increase in five consecutive reads. Funding has flipped NEGATIVE to -0.00102% into the 04:00Z settlement, from +0.00125% at midday: perpetual shorts are now paying longs to stay short. Both halves of the midday trigger fired for the first time in this file. Price is also above the daily ema50 at 64,366.4 - the wall midday named as 86.7 points overhead - which makes two daily EMAs reclaimed out of four. The window since the midday stamp ran 64,225.2 to 64,630.3, a 405.1-point range against midday's 987.9: the tape has stopped travelling and started holding.

decisionBox.changed: ADD for a fourth consecutive session, and this is the first one where BOTH published conditions were met before the desk acted. The three prior ADDs were taken on the price gate alone while the desk wrote, each time, that the participation it wanted had not arrived. It arrived tonight. Open interest is up $25,130,486 (+1.22%) to $2,078,856,250 - reversing four straight sessions of decline - funding has flipped negative to -0.00102%, the OKX long/short account ratio has fallen again to 1.52 from 1.70 at midday and 2.24 at yesterday's endday, and the realized feed shows $3,737,295 of SHORTS liquidated against $3,607 of longs in 8.7 hours, a ratio above 1,000-to-1. Retail is de-crowding from the long side while price rises and shorts are being paid to hold - that is a market where the marginal seller has been removed. The reduce line rises 245.5 points to 64,225.2 to sit under the daily ema50 reclaim. Invalidation rises 691.9 points from 63,287.8 to 63,979.7 - the 16:00Z 4H bar low, which is also midday's reduce line and 13.7 points under the 4H ema200 at 63,993.4. stopOrder flips to RECOMMENDED at 63,979.7 for the first time in three sessions: this is the last report before roughly 02:00 tomorrow, the gap window is where the file's worst outcomes have happened, and a resting stop is the only protection that works while nobody is watching. The honest counterweight, and it is the reason confidence sits at 6.75 rather than higher: 4H RSI is 70.03 and overbought, the 15m MACD histogram has flipped NEGATIVE from +20.53 to -7.22 while price rose, 1H RSI has cooled from 73.17 to 67.73 on a higher price - two bearish momentum divergences on the fast timeframes - and the ETF creation channel has still not published a single verified dollar behind a 1,900-point advance.

overnightRisk: The gap window runs roughly six and a half hours to the ~02:00 COT midnight report and it opens with price at the top of its range, three of four timeframes overbought or rolling over, and an empty liquidation map above 64,630.3. Four specific things to watch. FIRST, THE SQUEEZE IS SPENDING ITS OWN FUEL. $3,737,295 of shorts were liquidated in the last 8.7 hours against $3,607 of longs. Short squeezes end when the shorts run out, and the burn map now shows $1,460,410 at 64,600 and $990,609 at 64,500 already consumed - that is the fuel that carried this leg, and it has been used. If the tape stalls under 64,630.3 with no new shorts stepping in, the bid that has been mechanical becomes discretionary, and discretionary bids do not work overnight. SECOND, THERE IS ALSO ALMOST NOTHING BELOW. Only $3,138 of long liquidations printed all evening, at 64,000. That cuts both ways: a drop will not cascade on leverage, but it also means there is no forced-buying shelf to catch price between 64,225.2 and 63,979.7. A drift lower has no mechanical floor until the 4H ema200 at 63,993.4. THIRD, THE ETF CHANNEL IS STILL DARK. Farside's last settled row is still 14 August at -$56.2m and no 17 August row has published at all; BTC has run roughly 1,900 points off the 16 August low with zero verified creations behind it. When that row prints - typically in the small hours - a fourth consecutive negative session would be the first hard evidence that the institutional bid never showed, and it would land squarely inside this gap. FOURTH, MACRO IS NOT HELPING. US equities closed lower on all three tracked ETFs (QQQ -0.16%, VOO -0.47%, JPXN -0.21%), Brent is 91.08 and the 10-year is 4.728% - both up on the day - and the US-Iran 60-day ceasefire window is reported to be expiring, which is a headline risk that trades in Asian hours while the US is asleep. The plan: the resting stop at 63,979.7 is the whole overnight position. Do not add into the gap, do not chase 64,630.3 without a settled 4H close, and read the long/short account ratio before the price when the midnight report opens - if it is still falling on a higher price, the de-crowding thesis is intact; if it has snapped back above 1.70, the crowd has re-joined the long side at the highs and the squeeze is finished.

calibration.note: The prior report is today's 2026-08-17-midday, published at 12:55:00-05:00 with spot at 64,273.2. Its reduce line at 63,979.7 did NOT fire and was never approached - the lowest 1H low in the window was 64,262.7, a clear 283.0 points above it, and no bar came close to settling through. Its add gate at 64,427.4 DID fire: the 20:00Z 4H bar settled at 64,532.4, 105.0 points clear, on the settled-close mechanism midday specified rather than an intraday wick. actingHelped is TRUE. Midday bought 14 USDT of spot at 64,273.2, roughly 0.00021782 BTC, and spot marks 166.8 points higher at 64,440.0 - about +0.036 USDT. Small, and the fourth consecutive positive session. What matters more than the 0.036 is the resolution of the qualifier midday attached to its own trade. Midday sized at 14 rather than the full 32 for one stated reason: the price gate had fired but open interest was still falling, so the desk judged the move to be short covering rather than a real buyer and refused to pay full size for it. Six and three quarter hours later open interest is UP 1.22% to $2,078,856,250, funding has flipped negative, and the long/short account ratio has fallen another 0.18 to 1.52. The buyer midday said had not arrived, arrived. The correct grade on that decision is nuanced and should be recorded as such: the CAUTION was right at the moment it was written and the RESERVATION has since been resolved against it. Midday's restraint cost roughly 18 USDT of participation at 64,273.2 - about 0.047 USDT of foregone gain - which is a cheap price for being wrong about a thing that had not yet happened. The pattern worth logging across 16-17 August is the inverse of the 14-16 August fault. That fault was arguing against a trade and taking it anyway at reduced size. This one is naming a falsifiable confirmation, refusing to pretend it had arrived, sizing down honestly, and then acting on it the moment it did arrive. Three sessions of stated-condition discipline have now produced three positive marks and one confirmed trigger.
